title: Coherated sheaf derived Hom adjunction for a qcqs pushforward
statement: Let X and Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, and let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image] have right adjoint a [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint], with counit (the sheafy trace) Rf_*a(K)\to K. For L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) and K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y), composition with this counit induces a natural map in D(\mathcal O_Y), $$Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(L,a(K))\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(Rf_*L,K).$$ After applying the coherator DQ_Y:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y), this map is an isomorphism.
